title: Claude Code vs GitHub Copilot: The Real Differences in 2026
summary: Claude Code vs GitHub Copilot: honest 2026 comparison of pricing, features, and use cases. Includes Copilot's June 2026 usage-based billing change and real cost analysis.
body_markdown: GitHub Copilot moved to usage-based AI Credits billing on June 1, 2026. Plans: Free ($0, 2,000 completions/month with limited chat), Pro ($10/month), Pro+ ($39/month), Max ($100/month). Heavy agent-mode users on the old flat-rate Pro plan reported cost spikes of 10x-50x after the switch — credits deplete quickly during extended agent sessions. Claude Code: ~$20/month via Claude Pro with usage limits, or per-token API pricing (expect $30-150/month for intensive use on a large codebase). Blink: free to start — database, auth, and hosting included. No separate Supabase, Vercel, or Auth0 accounts needed;[Blink](https://blink.new/) often replaces $100+/month in infrastructure subscriptions that developers managing their own stack pay separately.
